mapper.sql: id, analysis_result_id, analysis_task_id, object_type, object_id, analysis_type, sentiment, suggested_risk_level, summary, keywords, similar_object_ids, confidence, result_payload, assistive_label, adoption_status, reviewer_user_id, review_time, review_opinion, deleted, create_user_id, update_user_id, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO campus_analysis_result ( analysis_result_id, analysis_task_id, object_type, object_id, analysis_type, sentiment, suggested_risk_level, summary, keywords, similar_object_ids, confidence, result_payload, assistive_label, adoption_status, deleted, create_user_id, update_user_id ) VALUES ( #{analysisResultId}, #{analysisTaskId}, #{objectType}, #{objectId}, #{analysisType}, #{sentiment}, #{suggestedRiskLevel}, #{summary}, #{keywords}, #{similarObjectIds}, #{confidence}, #{resultPayload}, #{assistiveLabel}, #{adoptionStatus}, #{deleted}, #{createUserId}, #{updateUserId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE campus_analysis_result SET adoption_status = #{adoptionStatus}, review_opinion = #{reviewOpinion}, reviewer_user_id = #{reviewerUserId}, review_time = NOW(), update_user_id = #{updateUserId} WHERE analysis_result_id = #{analysisResultId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM campus_analysis_result WHERE analysis_result_id = #{analysisResultId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
